summary: Phase 2 end-to-end verification PASSED. Regression: 13/13 task_engine tests still pass. Frontend: Login flow stores equine_token + equine_refresh_token in localStorage; NotificationsBell visible with unread badge '1' (testid=notifications-btn, not notifications-bell); panel opens on click. /owner-portal renders 'Care Timeline' with 'Wellness-focused milestones only' subtitle, horse picker chips, day-grouped entries (medication/vet/feed/farrier only). /horses/{id} new 'Timeline' tab present + renders unfiltered engine timeline (skipped/completed events visible). /feed shows Morning/Midday/Evening buckets backed by engine with optimistic Mark buttons + 1-of-10 completed counter. /medications shows Today's doses (engine) + Active prescriptions (templates) with Given/Refused buttons. /health shows 'Upcoming visits' card above legacy vet/injury records. /settings shows Notification preferences card with In-app inbox + Email channel toggles + event×category checkbox matrix (Completed/Skipped/Reverted rows × Medication/Farrier/Vet/Rehab/Feed/Turnout out/Turnout in/Stall clean/Custom cols). Zero error elements across regression sweep (/, /today, /barn-board, /horses, /onboarding, /reports, /messaging, /billing).
critical_code_review_comments: auth_security.py SecurityHeadersMiddleware verified in production response: X-Frame-Options=DENY, X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff, Referrer-Policy=strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Permissions-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy=same-origin, X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies=none, full CSP all present.

server.py is now 1798 lines (down from prior, but still >700-line guideline). Partial refactor (auth → routes/auth.py) is good; recommend completing extraction of other domain routes (notifications router is already separate) to bring server.py under 700.

task creation API accepts both 'horse_id' and 'linked_horse_ids' but only the latter actually populates linked_horse_ids; horse_id silently dropped. Consider adding either alias support or 422 validation to avoid silent data loss for naive API callers.
